import sys

def is_palindrome(s):
    return s == s[::-1]

def main():
    import sys
    s = sys.stdin.read().strip()
    n = len(s)
    total_degree = 0
    for i in range(1, n + 1):
        current_degree = 0
        prefix = s[:i]
        while is_palindrome(prefix):
            current_degree += 1
            prefix = prefix[1:-1]
        total_degree += current_degree
    print(total_degree)

main()
